edits.new:
Then no service is swapped and every previous copy stays in use, and a missing schema fails the run before any file is read with MSG-P1-002

  Scenario: AC9 A consumed call fails or does not answer (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a consumed call that the masked copy load needs, the authorise call of rwb-access or the reference-data call of rwb-case, fails or does not answer
    When the masked copy load starts for SIT
    Then the system refuses the load in full and no staging schema is swapped
    Then the previous copy stays in use

  Scenario: AC10 A status change the status model does not allow is refused (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a masked copy load run into SIT is in a status from which the requested change is not allowed by the status model
    When the change is requested
    Then the system refuses the change
    Then the run keeps its status
